children: Galaxy Digital's institutional USDC and USDT vaults go live on Kamino, bringing Galaxy Curation's institutional risk framework to Solana. The launch forms part of Galaxy's broader on-chain finance expansion and represents the curation arm's first deployment on the network, placing a Nasdaq-listed digital asset firm's risk standards behind Kamino's lending vaults.

Galaxy Curation applies an institutional risk framework to vault selection and collateral standards, so its arrival gives Kamino a curation layer backed by a firm managing over $7 billion in assets. This positions Kamino's curation function as an institutional entry point for Solana lending.

For KMNO, the launch supports a growth thesis in which institutional capital reaches Solana through a recognized risk provider. The practical effect will depend on how much institutional flow the vaults attract after going live.
